description: Search posts inside one subreddit — not subreddit discovery. Same sort/timeframe as site-wide Search. Flat 2 credits. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Leave empty for the first page; then pass the nextCursor value returned in the previous response.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 25, max 200). Flat 2 credits per call.

sort.description: relevance (default) | new | top | hot | comments (alias: comment_count).

timeframe.description: For sort=top or comments: hour | day | week | month | year | all (default all).

url.description: Subreddit URL, r/name, or bare name, e.g. r/technology. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.

name: reddit_subreddit_search
title: Reddit Subreddit Post Search
